name: Coherence
description: Measures how well the response follows the conversation context

name: Relevance
description: Evaluates how relevant the response is to the previous message

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the response's ability to keep the conversation engaging

name: Contextual Understanding
description: Measures the response's understanding of the conversation context

name: Response Adequacy
description: Evaluates the response's ability to provide a suitable answer
